description: List the individual contacts currently enrolled in a sequence, with the node each one is sitting on. Use this when get_sequence_stats gives you enrollmentCounts and you need the actual subscribers behind a number, such as everyone waiting at one step. Filter by currentNodeId (take the ID from get_sequence_stats enrollmentCounts.byCurrentNode or get_sequence nodes), status, subscriberId, or email, and page with limit/offset to export the full list. The response always echoes the sequence's single configured stopCondition, including matchConfig filters or comparisons. A stop condition does not cancel a waiting enrollment when its event arrives: it is re-evaluated when the enrollment next runs a step, so an enrollment parked on a delay keeps reporting `waiting` until that delay expires. Pass stopConditionMatch true to see whether each in-flight enrollment's stop condition matches right now. This is a non-atomic snapshot: a step already past its stop check may still finish. Each enrollment also reports enteredVia - the list, tag, segment, event, inactivity check, or frequency check that enrolled it - which is how you tell apart contacts entering a sequence whose trigger covers several lists or tags. entryContext adds the event id, property keys (never values), and trigger type. branchDecisions records the bounded retained if/else (or random split) verdicts, including the compared field name and a redacted value summary (missing/empty/nonempty/equals_expected); branchDecisionCount and branchDecisionsTruncated tell you when older verdicts were omitted. For the ClickHouse graph walk of one completed token, use get_sequence_enrollment. Live sequence tests do not create enrollments; they send isolated test emails and record activity on the sequence test run instead.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

currentNodeId.description: Only return enrollments currently sitting on these sequence node IDs.

email.description: Only return enrollments for this exact email address (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Enrollments per page, 1-500. Defaults to 50. Use the maximum when exporting. Capped at 100 when stopConditionMatch is true.

offset.description: Number of enrollments to skip. Page until pagination.hasMore is false.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID whose enrollments should be listed.

sort.description: Result order. Defaults to enrolled_at_desc (most recently enrolled first). Use wait_until_asc to see who resumes next.

status.description: Enrollment statuses to include. Defaults to active, waiting, and paused, which is every contact still in the sequence. paused means held by pause_sequence_subscribers.

stopConditionMatch.description: Annotate each returned active or waiting enrollment with whether the sequence's stop condition matches for that contact right now, using the same evaluation the worker runs before each step. Use this to confirm a stop event, tag, or field change registered without waiting out the current delay: a matching enrollment can still report `waiting`, so status alone cannot tell you. This is a non-atomic snapshot, not a promise of a future exit: the condition can change, a paused sequence may not run on schedule, and a step already past its stop check may still finish. Each annotated enrollment costs an evaluation, so this caps the page at 100 regardless of limit; stopConditionMatchEvaluatedCount reports how many were actually evaluated. Defaults to false.

subscriberId.description: Only return enrollments for these subscriber IDs. Useful for checking where specific contacts stand.

name: list_sequence_enrollments

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_sequence_enrollments` MCP tool.

enrollments.description: Contact-level enrollments matching the filters, one row per enrollment token.

items.description: One subscriber's enrollment in this sequence.

branchDecisionCount.description: Total branch and condition decisions taken, including decisions omitted from the bounded array.

branchDecisions.description: Bounded redacted if/else and random-split verdicts, oldest first within the retained window. Compared values are summaries (missing, empty, nonempty, equals_expected), never the raw field or event-property value. Empty on enrollments recorded before this field existed; use get_sequence_enrollment to reconstruct those from ClickHouse.

items.description: One branch or condition decision, including selectedPath and per-branch evaluations.

branchDecisionsTruncated.description: Whether older decisions were omitted from branchDecisions.

currentNodeId.description: Sequence node this enrollment is currently sitting on.

currentNodeLabel.description: Current sequence node label or email subject when available.

currentNodeMissing.description: Whether the current node no longer exists in the sequence graph.

currentNodeType.description: Current sequence node type. Omitted when the node no longer exists in the graph.

email.description: Subscriber email address. Falls back to the address captured at enrollment when the subscriber record no longer exists, and is null when neither is known.

enrollmentId.description: Enrollment token ID. Stable identifier for this one run through the sequence.

enrollmentKey.description: Key that distinguishes concurrent enrollments of the same subscriber in this sequence.

enrollmentStartedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this enrollment entered the sequence.

enteredVia.description: What put this contact into the sequence. Use this to distinguish which list or tag matched a multi-value trigger.

description.description: Ready-to-display description of the entry source.

kind.description: Entry source kind: list, tag, segment, event, inactivity, frequency, manual, test_run, or unknown.

name.description: Resolved display name for list and segment sources, or null when not applicable or deleted.

value.description: Raw list ID, tag name, segment ID, event name, or monitored event name. Null for manual, test_run, and unknown.

entryContext.description: Event or manual-enrollment context captured at entry. Property keys only; values are never returned.

eventId.description: Durable ID of the enrolling event, or null.

eventPropertyKeys.description: Keys present on the enrolling event payload. Values are omitted.

fieldSnapshotKeys.description: Subscriber field paths snapshotted at enrollment. Values are omitted.

hasEventProperties.description: Whether any event property keys were stored on this enrollment.

hasFieldSnapshots.description: Whether subscriber field snapshots were stored at enrollment.

triggerType.description: Stored entryTriggerType, such as event_received or manual_enrollment. Null when never stamped.

failedReason.description: Why this enrollment stopped, for status `failed`. Null for every other status and for failures recorded before this field existed. A reason repeated across enrollments on the same currentNodeId points at that step's configuration or content rather than at the contacts.

firstName.description: Subscriber first name, or null when unset.

lastName.description: Subscriber last name, or null when unset.

lastUpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change to this enrollment. For a waiting enrollment this is when it arrived at its current node; the platform does not separately track node entry time.

moveReason.description: Note recorded with that release, or null when none was given.

movedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of that release, or null when the enrollment was never moved.

movedFromNodeId.description: Step this enrollment was released from by move_sequence_enrollments, or null when it reached its current step on its own.

pauseReason.description: Reason passed to pause_sequence_subscribers, or null.

pausedAt.description: When pause_sequence_subscribers paused this enrollment, or null when it is not paused.

status.description: Enrollment status: active, waiting, paused, completed, failed, or cancelled.

stopConditionMatchReason.description: Human-readable reason the stop condition matches, such as the stop event or tag that satisfied it. Null when stopConditionMatches is not true.

stopConditionMatches.description: Whether the sequence's stop condition matches for this contact right now. Null when it was not determined: stopConditionMatch was not requested, the sequence has no stop condition, this enrollment is no longer active or waiting, or it fell outside the evaluated window. Null never means `does not match`. This is a non-atomic snapshot: the worker re-checks before a future step, but the condition can change and a step already past its stop check may still finish.

subscriberStatus.description: Subscriber status (active, unsubscribed, bounced), or null when the subscriber record no longer exists.

waitUntil.description: ISO 8601 timestamp this enrollment is scheduled to resume, or null when nothing is scheduled.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID these enrollments belong to.

statuses.description: Enrollment statuses included in this response. Defaults to active, waiting, and paused.

stopCondition.description: The sequence's single configured stop condition: `type` (`none` when unset), `value`, and nullable `matchConfig` containing event-property filters, a field comparison, or entry_audience resolution. For entry_audience, value is null and audience identifies the enrolling tag or list resolved per contact. Stop conditions are re-evaluated when an enrollment next runs a step, not when their event arrives.

stopConditionMatchEvaluatedCount.description: How many enrollments in this page were actually evaluated for a current stop-condition match. 0 when stopConditionMatch was not requested, the sequence has no stop condition, or no returned enrollment was still active or waiting.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
